subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the three preceding Matrix QA stack PRs land, should maintainers authorize exact head `8f79563535b19c3c87a9c22f41b6ae1a099cdc1a` to remove the temporary `qa-matrix` package, importer, and private runtime compatibility surface?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but package-graph authorization and acceptance of the temporary compatibility-surface removal are explicit repository-owner decisions that automation cannot make.

options.title: Authorize after stack lands
options.body: Land the preceding stack in order, revalidate the exact head and base relationship, approve the intentional package removal, and merge this cleanup.

options.title: Retain the compatibility package
options.body: Keep the temporary package and facade until maintainers identify a concrete source-checkout consumer or choose a later removal window.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Defer this PR if the preceding stack will not land as designed, because the cleanup should not merge independently.

recommendation.title: Authorize after stack lands
recommendation.body: Land the preceding stack in order, revalidate the exact head and base relationship, approve the intentional package removal, and merge this cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QA Lab and repository-boundary history makes this person the best available routing candidate for the compatibility and package-removal choice.
